label: A common first esse giver from one actual bearer and well-founded causes
meaning: Keep the ancestry principle, at-most-one identity bearer, well-foundedness and excluded middle of 5ab6cc2b. One actual bearer suffices: if it has represented esse–essence identity, use it directly, and if distinct, use its supplied identity ancestor. The inherited one-bearer argument identifies the selected identity bearer as the common source and excludes actual incoming supply by ruling out a nonempty return path. All premises are recorded explicitly. The conclusion supplies only the common source in the fixed esse profile.

strong_version_needed.ee4ab504-c8fe-59bc-bc96-7cbeefed6410: The arbitrary initial actual bearer need not be a GOD_4 candidate. Its represented esse–essence identity is decided before any identity source is selected. ca432e24 only decides equality of actual bearers against a GOD_4 candidate and permits double-negation elimination for that candidate's esse–essence equality.
strong_version_needed.fd12ad3d-6729-4fa0-bb87-0121260df684: This sibling specializes the original well-founded route's population input. Well-foundedness is used only to exclude nonempty returns at actual identity bearers. Result 7a970bf6-1168-4c45-bf3c-9a0a1e4a8615, commonSourceOfNoIdentityReturn, already uses that weaker sufficient condition.
